format: podcast 16:9, 1920x1080: one host picture + waveform + karaoke captions
note: Lab H25 video 2 (H10 folded in): the 60 approved 'very' words of podcast-stop-saying-very-60-v1 (same sentences) + 40 new words in 8 new families (cold, hot, short, clean, loud, difficult, rich, surprised). Per word: 'Instead of very X, say Y', the sentence, pause, the sentence again, pause.

card.headline: 100 Synonyms for "Very"

beats.speech: Stop saying very. Here are one hundred better words. Listen and repeat. You will hear a stronger word, and then the word in a sentence. Say the sentence out loud in the pause. Then you hear it again, and you say it again. You don't need to look at the screen. Let's start.
